changelog: Vortex v5.0.9: The login now restarts the Riot Client first to clear any stale state, and checks every step instead of guessing on timers - VALORANT closed, session signed out, client fully open and showing the sign-in screen, and the username and password actually landing in their boxes. Nothing is submitted unless both fields verified, so a failed login no longer burns a Riot rate-limit attempt and the error names the step that failed.
